content.title: KITCHEN {{FIXES}} FOR EVERYDAY ANNOYANCES
facts: Hiccups – Swallow a **teaspoon of sugar** to help reset the nerve signal causing the spasm.
Bad Breath – Chew a sprig of **fresh parsley** to neutralize odor-causing sulfur compounds.
Nosebleed – Pinch the **soft part of your nose** and lean slightly forward for five minutes.
Sunburn – Apply **cool plain yogurt** to the skin to ease heat and calm irritation.
Muscle Cramp – Press firmly on your **upper lip** for thirty seconds to interrupt the nerve signal.
Dry Cough – Sip **warm water with honey** to coat and soothe an irritated throat.
Canker Sore – Rinse with **warm salt water** a few times a day to reduce irritation.
Brain Freeze – Press your **tongue** flat against the roof of your mouth to warm it quickly.
